integrity: Finite-field enumeration corroborates only tested small instances; the arbitrary-field and all-dimension statements rest on an explicit algebraic proof. No external validation or publication-priority certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform statement concerns null-filiform right Leibniz algebras and linear local derivations; arbitrary nonlinear one-local maps and general filiform families are outside scope. The standard ordinary-derivation formula and characteristic-zero local classification are prior results; full historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Modular local derivations and two-local rigidity of null-filiform Leibniz algebras
